title: Business Central EDI Inbound Sales Document
description: Schema for EDI inbound sales document API. Only one order can be transmitted per API call. Each order must contain at least one line item. IMPORTANT: Order amendments and cancellations are NOT supported in this API. Only new order creation is supported in the current implementation (MVP).

integrationCode.description: Code used to identify the source system. Mandatory field. Must exist in Integration nH table.

tradingPartyCode.description: Trading Party Code from the nHanced Integration Record. Will be auto-populated from Integration record.

ediCreationDate.description: Date the EDI message was created. Mandatory field.

ediCreationTime.description: Time the EDI message was created. Mandatory field.

customerNo.description: Customer number for the sales document. Mandatory field. Must exist in BC.

ediInboundTransactionRef.description: Reference for the EDI transaction. Mandatory field. Must be unique within the table.

shipToCode.description: Ship-to address code. Mandatory if Ship-To Code Validation is TRUE in Integration nH.

shipmentContact.description: Contact person at the ship-to address.

orderDate.description: Date when the order was placed.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: Date requested by the customer for the delivery of the document.

currencyCode.description: Currency code for the sales document. If matches LCY code, then BLANK.

inboundSalesDocumentLines.description: Line items for the sales document. At least one line item is required. Multiple lines can be included per sales header. Each line will be processed according to specific business rules. Only Type=Item is supported (no GL Line Types).

oneOf.description: If using Item Reference Number for item identification. When provided, the system will look up the item using the Item References table where Reference Type = Customer and Reference No matches this value.
If using direct Item Number for item identification. When provided, the system will directly look up the item using this number in the Item table.

ediLineNo.description: Line number from the EDI system. Mandatory field.

type.description: Specifies the type of the line. Only 'Item' is supported in the current implementation. Other standard Business Central types like G/L Account, Resource, Fixed Asset, Charge (Item) are not supported.

itemReferenceNo.description: Item reference number. Mandatory if No. is blank.

no.description: Item number. Mandatory if Item Reference No. is blank.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item. Mandatory field. Must be greater than zero.
